icons.name: search
icons.heading: Search
icons.description: The search finds something. Light: the magnifier glides out to the left, scanning, and comes back to land on its spot with a hit; the lens pops as it finds, and a glint draws on inside the lens and fades. Strong: it scans left and then right before landing, the lens pops harder with a rebound, and the glint snaps on.
